lead_fa: Holy Paladin یک هیلی سنتی با بازی Holy Power است که شفای تک‌هدف قدرتمند و دیفنزهای بیرونی مانند [[Blessing of Sacrifice]] را با هم ترکیب می‌کند. در Midnight با باف‌های بزرگ پچ 12.1 به یکی از هیلی‌های قوی فصل تبدیل شده است. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Herald of the Sun]] با تراپوت بالاتر برای ریید و Mythic+، و [[Lightsmith]] با Holy Armaments و پشتیبانی دفاعی از گروه.

strengths: Good survivability including an immunity (Divine Shield)
Powerful external defensives: Blessing of Sacrifice and Blessing of Protection
Aura Mastery empowers Paladin auras; paired with Devotion Aura it becomes a powerful raid-wide damage reduction
weaknesses: Holy Power can be an unintuitive resource system
Has to spend healing cooldowns and resources to deal damage

buffs: Eternal Flame and Word of Glory healing increased by 20.75%
Pillars of Light healing increased by 50%
Ringing of the Heavens now casts Divine Toll at 200% effectiveness (was 100%)
changes_12_1.note: These buffs were huge and explain why Holy Paladin is much stronger in Season 2 than in Season 1.

hero.recommendation: Raid: Herald of the Sun is the go-to option; it buffs Holy Shock significantly and has access to Eternal Flame which heals more than Word of Glory, so it simply has more throughput. Mythic+: Herald of the Sun is also the default thanks to better reactive healing and higher overall throughput. Lightsmith focuses on group defensiveness and damage via Holy Bulwark and Sacred Weapon, and grants extra Infusion of Light procs through Laying Down Arms for spot healing.
hero.herald_of_the_sun: Enhances Holy Shock and Holy Power spenders: Word of Glory is replaced by Eternal Flame (heals slightly more plus a small HoT); adds Dawnlight as a decently sized HoT and Sun's Avatar creates beams of light from you to those Dawnlights, continuously healing anyone inside them.
hero.lightsmith: Increases the group's defensiveness and damage output with Holy Bulwark and Sacred Weapon; Laying Down Arms grants many free Infusion of Light procs, letting you rely less on Holy Shock and save mana for Holy Light.
hero.beacon_note: Beacon of Faith builds use less mana and allow more Holy Light casts (easier to play); Beacon of Virtue builds provide stronger burst healing and higher overall HPS if you can use Beacon of Virtue close to on cooldown. Lightsmith pairs best with Beacon of Faith because that hero tree generates too many resources to spend all of them.

builds.codes_source: Wowhead 'Best Holy Paladin Talent Builds' page (wowhead.com/guide/classes/paladin/holy/talent-builds-pve-healer), export strings captured verbatim from each build row's /talent-calc/blizzard/ link on 2026-10-27; do not modify. Each mode has a Beacon of Virtue and a Beacon of Faith variant.

concepts: Avoid wasting Holy Power: it is your main healing resource spent on Word of Glory and Light of Dawn; with nothing to heal, spend it on Shield of the Righteous for damage; never press a Holy Power generator at 5 Holy Power.
ABC - Always Be Casting: fill every global cooldown; a suboptimal spell beats no spell.
Use cooldowns often: get as many uses as possible instead of saving them 'for later'; only hold them when you know you must.
Spend and generate Holy Power constantly.
Do not sit on your cooldowns.
Do not waste Infusion of Light procs.
st_priority: Cast Beacon of Virtue for AoE healing
Spend Holy Power if at 5 Holy Power
Cast Divine Toll on an ally
Cast Holy Shock on an ally
Cast Holy Light as needed and as mana allows
During Beacon of Virtue, cast Flash of Light
rotation.aoe_note: The AoE priority mirrors single target: the list is the same; Beacon of Virtue is your AoE entry point and Light of Dawn spends Holy Power on the group.

cooldowns.Divine Toll: Use close to on cooldown when you will not cause excessive overhealing.
cooldowns.Avenging Wrath: Strive to get as many uses as possible.
cooldowns.Aura Mastery: Use while Beacon of Virtue is running with Ringing of the Heavens.

rotation.hero_notes: As Lightsmith you get many free Infusion of Light procs from Laying Down Arms: rely less on Holy Shock, save mana for more Holy Light; with the Season 2 4-piece each Holy Light also grants an Infusion of Light proc. Avoid Holy Shock related talents as Lightsmith; use Holy Shock for healing only in low-damage periods. Holy Armaments: prioritize Holy Bulwark on squishy targets (casting it on yourself routes the Solidarity copy onto a tank); cast Sacred Weapon on yourself to maximize healing; press Holy Armaments on cooldown when you need 3 Holy Power and avoid using it above 2 Holy Power; overwriting an existing Holy Bulwark or Sacred Weapon immediately procs an Infusion of Light.
pre_combat: Pre-cast Holy Light and queue Beacon of Virtue at the end of the Holy Light cast
rotation.damage_notes: Shield of the Righteous can be used for damage when you do not need healing, as it returns mana; in Mythic+ use Holy Shock to fill globals. As Herald of the Sun, Divine Toll and Holy Prism apply 2 Dawnlights: Eternal Flame places them on specific targets, Light of Dawn on random targets.

gearing_rules: Weapon and Shield are always your best items to prioritize for high item level.
Strong Trinkets scale well with item level and are not easily replaced.
After weapon, shield and trinkets, upgrade high-stat pieces such as Chest, Legs and Helmet.

tier_set.name: Radiance of the Consecrated Flame
tier_set.note: 2pc: Infusion of Light increases the healing of Flash of Light by an additional 100% and the absorb from Greater Judgment by an additional 100%. 4pc: Judgment has a 20% chance to grant Infusion of Light; Holy Light now always grants Infusion of Light but its mana cost is increased by 50%.

stats.cheatsheet: Intellect >> Mastery > Haste = Crit > Versatility; all secondary stats are close in value, so item level generally wins until near max ilvl; try to keep Crit and Haste rating somewhat similar.
notes: All secondary stats are good and close in value; do not over-optimize stats before near-maximum item level.
Mastery (Lightbringer) heals targets standing in your Consecration and scales your Mastery-driven throughput.
Keep Crit and Haste rating roughly similar for consistent Infusion of Light flow and cast speed.
stats.dr_breakpoints: Diminishing returns start above: Critical Strike 1380, Haste 1320, Mastery 1380, Versatility 1620 rating.

enchants.chest: Enchant Chest - Mark of the Magister

mplus.hero_note: Herald of the Sun is the default Hero Talent in Mythic+ due to better reactive healing and higher throughput; Lightsmith is playable and pairs with Beacon of Faith builds for easier mana management.
tips: Blessing of Sacrifice and Blessing of Protection are powerful external defensives for dangerous pulls and trap mechanics.
Divine Shield is a personal immunity for specific mechanics; Blessing of Protection can also clear hostile bleeds from a target.
Aura Mastery with Devotion Aura is a strong raid/party-wide damage reduction cooldown.
Use Holy Shock to fill globals during movement and Shield of the Righteous for free damage that returns mana.
Poor mobility is the main weakness: plan positioning around mechanics since you lack reliable movement tools.
